Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From re- +‎ encontrar.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁe.ẽ.kõˈtɾa(ʁ)/ [he.ẽ.kõˈtɾa(h)], /ʁe.ĩ.kõˈtɾa(ʁ)/ [he.ĩ.kõˈtɾa(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁe.ẽ.kõˈtɾa(ʁ)/ [he.ẽ.kõˈtɾa(h)], /ʁe.ĩ.kõˈtɾa(ʁ)/ [he.ĩ.kõˈtɾa(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /ʁe.ẽ.kõˈtɾa(ɾ)/ [he.ẽ.kõˈtɾa(ɾ)], /ʁe.ĩ.kõˈtɾa(ɾ)/ [he.ĩ.kõˈtɾa(ɾ)]
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /ʁe.ẽ.kõˈtɾa(ʁ)/ [χe.ẽ.kõˈtɾa(χ)], /ʁe.ĩ.kõˈtɾa(ʁ)/ [χe.ĩ.kõˈtɾa(χ)]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /ʁe.ẽ.kõˈtɾa(ɻ)/ [he.ẽ.kõˈtɾa(ɻ)], /ʁe.ĩ.kõˈtɾa(ɻ)/ [he.ĩ.kõˈtɾa(ɻ)]
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁjẽ.kõˈtɾaɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁjẽ.kõˈtɾaɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁjẽ.kõˈtɾa.ɾi/

  • Hyphenation: re‧en‧con‧trar

Verb

[edit]

reencontrar (first-person singular present reencontro, first-person singular preterite reencontrei, past participle reencontrado)

  1. to rediscover; to refind (to find again)
    Synonym: redescobrir

Spanish

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • rencontrar

Etymology

[edit]

From re- +‎ encontrar.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /reenkonˈtɾaɾ/ [re.ẽŋ.kõn̪ˈt̪ɾaɾ]
  • Rhymes: -aɾ
  • Syllabification: re‧en‧con‧trar

Verb

[edit]

reencontrar (first-person singular present reencuentro, first-person singular preterite reencontré, past participle reencontrado)

  1. (transitive) to rediscover, to refind
    Synonym: redescubrir
